title: Local Binding (config.local.yml)
description: Gitignored personal overrides and instance-specific resolved ids at .specify/jira/config.local.yml. NEVER contains a credential (secrets resolve only via NFR-3). Validation MUST reject any credential-shaped value (FR-023): ATATT prefix, a real *.atlassian.net host, email/token shapes. The real site URL is a coordinate and is NOT stored here; only a non-secret alias is. Never destroyed by reinstall/upgrade (FR-020). Presented as JSON Schema; the on-disk file is YAML. (032: bound_site is the single exception — see its own description.)

site_alias.description: A non-secret human alias for the instance (e.g. 'prod'). The real site URL is resolved at runtime and never persisted here.

bound_site.description: 032: the Jira ORIGIN (scheme + host + port, canonical) this checkout is bound to. Written by the configuration ceremony from the site it actually reached; compared before the first request of every later run, which refuses when config.yml declares a different one. This is the third narrow exemption to the credential-shape guard (Constitution IV/V, v3.0.0) and it is per-key: a real site host is still refused at every OTHER key of this file. Distinct from site_alias, which keeps its meaning above and is neither read nor written by this mechanism.

resolved_ids.description: Instance-specific id resolutions cached locally when the team chooses not to commit them.

overrides.description: Per-user overrides of team config fields. Same schema constraints as the corresponding config.yml fields.
